CASE WHEN h.EMPLYR_ID IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.EMPLYR_ID IS NULL THEN 'NO_ACCOUNT' WHEN NOT (e.ORGNZT_ID <=> h.ORGNZT_ID) THEN 'MOVED' WHEN THEN 'VALID' WHEN IFNULL(e.LOCK_AT, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN 'NO_ROLE' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS s WHERE s.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = e.ESNTL_ID) THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END
FROM ASSET_DEPT_HEAD h LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO e ON e.EMPLYR_ID = h.EMPLYR_ID
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORGNZT_ID , o.ORGNZT_NM , h.EMPLYR_ID , e.USER_NM , h.ASSIGN_ID , DATE_FORMAT(h.ASSIGN_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ASSIGN_PNTTM , HEAD_STATUS FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO o LEFT JOIN ASSET_DEPT_HEAD h ON h.ORGNZT_ID = o.ORGNZT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO e ON e.EMPLYR_ID = h.EMPLYR_ID ORDER BY o.ORGNZT_ID LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO WHERE ORGNZT_ID = #{orgnztId}
SELECT e.EMPLYR_ID FROM COMTNEMPLYRINFO e JOIN COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS r ON r.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = e.ESNTL_ID AND r.AUTHOR_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN' WHERE ORDER BY e.EMPLYR_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_DEPT_HEAD (ORGNZT_ID, EMPLYR_ID, ASSIGN_ID, ASSIGN_PNTTM) VALUES (#{orgnztId}, #{emplyrId}, #{assignId}, SYSDATE()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE EMPLYR_ID = VALUES(EMPLYR_ID), ASSIGN_ID = VALUES(ASSIGN_ID), ASSIGN_PNTTM = VALUES(ASSIGN_PNTTM)
